svg.title: Projecting standardised data onto two directions
svg.desc: Sixty children's heights, measured in centimetres and in inches and standardised, lie close to the 45-degree line. Left: projected orthogonally onto that line, the projections spread widely and the projection segments are short. Right: projected onto the perpendicular line, the projections bunch near the origin and the segments are long.
svg.text: onto u₁: spread large, distances small
onto u₂: spread small, distances large
